Craft a Crafting Table, then record it with a Totem guide or a book.
advancements.deadrecall.excavation_manua: Use a guide or book on a Crafting Table to obtain the Excavation method guide.
book.totem.excavation_manual.title: Excavation Method Guide
book.totem.excavation_manual.page.1:
HAMMERS

Craft a hammer for your tool tier. Each tier limits the longest selectable axis and uses normal durability, harvest, loot, and protection rules.
book.totem.excavation_manual.page.2:
SELECT

Crouch-use an eligible block for Corner A, then another for Corner B. The selection is stored on that exact hammer.
book.totem.excavation_manual.page.3:
EXCAVATE

Break an eligible selected block normally to begin bounded server-side mining. Only loaded, permitted blocks are changed.
message.totem.excavation.selection.need_: Select the first mining corner while crouching first.
message.totem.excavation.selection.ineli: That block is not eligible for hammer excavation.
message.totem.excavation.selection.dimen: Both mining corners must be in the same dimension.
message.totem.excavation.selection.range: That area exceeds this hammer's %s-block axis limit.
message.totem.excavation.session.empty: No eligible loaded blocks remain in the selected area.
